_note: On-screen controller prompts (scripts/input_prompts.gd). 'buttons' is keyed by Godot's JoyButton number (A=0 Cross, B=1 Circle, X=2 Square, Y=3 Triangle, BACK=4 Share/Create, START=6 Options, LEFT_SHOULDER=9 L1, RIGHT_SHOULDER=10 R1, DPAD_UP..RIGHT=11..14, TOUCHPAD=20). 'glyph' is what is shown when the Korean font (art/fonts/NotoSansKR) has every character of it, else 'fallback' (the glyph U+2715 is not in that font, so Cross falls back to the multiplication sign). 'axes' is keyed by JoyAxis number. 'key_names' renames keys whose Godot name is long. 'stick_threshold' is how far a stick must be pushed to count as a press or to switch the prompts to the controller.
